Accepting a DR or approving a spec is a **human act** (DR-029, DR-086 §2), and it is docs-only by construction, so the docs corpus check above cannot see it. Auto-merge NOT enabled (#1847). This needs a human merge keystroke. Split any unrelated docs into their own PR if you want those on the lane.

## 🤖 AI review — `ai-review:changes`

### Reviewer
```
REVIEW_VERDICT_BEGIN

blocking: 2

findings:
- blocking docs/decisions/DR-095.md:4,459 and docs/decisions/INDEX.md:752,760 — This diff (agent-produced) flips DR-094 and DR-095 from status: proposed to accepted. Acceptance is a human-only act via 'MinSpec: Accept ADR', never minted by an agent — stated verbatim in DR-095's own body ('Acceptance is a human act via MinSpec: Accept ADR, never minted by an agent') and DR-094.md:15-17, and enforced by DR-029's born-gate. The session autonomy card also carves out 'approval-or-acceptance' from autonomous action. No evidence a human performed the acceptance; this must be reve…
- blocking docs/decisions/INDEX.md:760 vs docs/decisions/DR-094.md:4 — The diff sets DR-094 to 'accepted' in INDEX.md but does not update DR-094.md's frontmatter, which remains 'status: proposed' (confirmed at head, line 4). The INDEX summary would then contradict the authoritative source DR — a never-wrong / lying-signpost defect. The two must agree; the frontmatter status: field is authoritative, and only a human acceptance may change it.
REVIEW_VERDICT_END
```

### Architect (design / scope)
```
REVIEW_VERDICT_BEGIN
verdict: changes
blocking: 2
summary: An agent is promoting DR-095 (and the DR-094/DR-095 index entries) from proposed to accepted, which the DR and DR-029 reserve for a human act; DR-094's index status also now contradicts DR-094.md.
findings:
- blocking docs/decisions/DR-095.md:4 and :459 — Agent-authored diff flips DR-095 from proposed to accepted. The record itself states it is 'Born proposed per DR-029 (promoted by a human)' (line 15-16) and 'Acceptance is a human act via MinSpec: Accept ADR, never minted by an agent' (line 459). The session autonomy rules also gate 'approval-or-acceptance' to a human. This acceptance transition is not an agent-writable act.
- blocking docs/decisions/INDEX.md:752 (DR-094 entry) vs docs/decisions/DR-094.md:4 — INDEX.md marks DR-094 'accepted', but DR-094.md frontmatter still reads status: proposed. The index summary is a derived record (auto= hash on the adjacent line); editing only the index leaves the register internally inconsistent and the authoritative status field untouched.
REVIEW_VERDICT_END
```

### Skeptic (evidence discipline)
```
REVIEW_VERDICT_BEGIN
verdict: changes
blocking: 2
summary: Status flips to "accepted" are unproven and internally contradictory: INDEX says DR-094 accepted while DR-094.md frontmatter stays proposed, and acceptance is minted in an agent diff that DR-029 forbids.
findings:
- blocking docs/decisions/INDEX.md:752 (DR-094 summary) vs docs/decisions/DR-094.md:4 — The diff flips the INDEX summary for DR-094 to 'Status: accepted' but does NOT touch DR-094.md, whose authoritative frontmatter remains 'status: proposed'. Post-merge the signpost contradicts the owning record's status field — the exact false-signpost class the repo's Evidence Discipline rule (authoritative status = the record's own frontmatter) and DR-094's own header note forbid. No proof of acceptance is cited; the INDEX change has no backing artifact.
- blocking docs/decisions/DR-095.md:4 and :459; INDEX.md:760 — Acceptance ('proposed' → 'accepted') is minted inside an agent-authored diff with no citable evidence of the human 'MinSpec: Accept ADR' act. DR-095's own body states acceptance is 'a human act ... never minted by an agent', both records carry the DR-029 born-proposed note, and the session autonomy config lists 'approval-or-acceptance' as an exception requiring the human. An acceptance claim contradicted by its own referenced process and unsupported by any proof is an automatic-fail for the evi…
REVIEW_VERDICT_END
```

_Independent fresh-context reviewers (`scripts/review-branch.sh`, no-tools agents reading the diff as untrusted data); each label decided by the deterministic fail-closed gate (`scripts/review-decide.sh`). Posted by `minspec-sdd[bot]` from CI — provenance is the App identity, verified here, not the label alone (#428, #342). Coverage `panel` — voters that ran: **reviewer + architect + skeptic**. Did NOT run: **security** — docs-only change: every changed file is Markdown, so there is no code surface to review. The combined verdict fails toward `changes` if ANY voter requests changes._

**Provenance of this acceptance** - posted by `minspec-sdd[bot]`, an agent identity. This is a factual record for reviewers. It is not a review, and it is not the founder's sign-off.

- **His Alt+A.** This PR was opened by the MinSpec extension's accept command after the founder pressed Alt+A (**MinSpec: Approve/Accept Active**) on `docs/decisions/DR-095.md`. Checkable with `git log`: acceptance commit `2261ba71` is authored and committed by Paul Harvey `<github@harvest316.com>` at 2026-10-01T08:17:57+10:00. Its subject, `chore(accept): DR-095 → accepted`, is the string built at `packages/minspec/src/commands/adr.ts:262`, and the branch name has the shape `approvalBranchName` mints (`packages/minspec/src/lib/approve-push.ts:128`). The PR was opened under his GitHub account, `harvest316`.
- **His word.** His reply to the queue-proxy session's item asking him to accept DR-094, DR-095 and DR-096 was, verbatim: "accepted". The queue-proxy session relayed it on 2026-10-01 and recorded it at 22:18:12 UTC on 2026-09-30 (08:18:12 AEST on 2026-10-01), seconds after the three acceptance commits. That record lives in the operator's task store outside this repository, so from here it is a relayed claim, not something this PR can prove.
- **What an agent changed afterwards**, as `minspec-sdd[bot]`:
  - Merged `origin/main` into this branch.
  - Restored DR-094's row in `docs/decisions/INDEX.md`. The extension regenerated the INDEX from a working tree that also held the uncommitted DR-094 acceptance, so this PR had flipped DR-094's row while `DR-094.md` here still reads `proposed` (#2021, Accept-ADR commits the whole regenerated INDEX). Re-running `regenerateDrIndex` on this branch leaves DR-095's own status row as the only difference from `main`.
  - Corrected the acceptance date in DR-095's Status paragraph. The writer had swapped `Proposed` for `Accepted` but kept the proposal date, so it read "Accepted 2026-09-25". It now reads "Accepted 2026-10-01 by the founder (AEST; 2026-09-30 UTC); proposed 2026-09-25". Nothing else in the record changed.
  - Removed the `docs-lane` label. The founder's installed extension predates #2089 (docs-lane label eligibility), so it applied a label the lane refuses for any governance status transition.
- **Not claimed here:** that the founder has reviewed this PR, or anything beyond the Alt+A and the relayed word. Arming or merging a first acceptance stays his own keystroke (#1847, docs-lane human merge).
